Mechanics: Teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space that the caster can see.]


Spells:
1st Level Spells:[
Intoxicating Aegis: For the next minute, a shimmering shield of alcoholic vapor envelopes the Boozemancer, granting a +5 bonus to AC. This vaporous guard has a slight chance to cause enemies that strike the Boozemancer at close range to become poisoned.

Booze Bolt: Cast as an action, flings a bolt of condensed spirits in a straight line up to 30 feet. On hit, deals 1d10 force damage and has a chance to confuse the target, potentially causing them to attack a random creature within range on their next turn.

Bender's Brew: Cast as an action, creates a volatile concoction that splashes a 10-foot radius sphere up to 20 feet away. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw or become disoriented from the intoxicating fumes, suffering disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks for 1d4 rounds.

Liquid Bravado: Cast as a reaction when taking damage, consumes a swig of liquid courage to temporarily numb the pain. The Boozemancer regains 1d8 hit points plus an additional 1d8 hit points for every two levels beyond the first, and gains temporary hit points equal to their Constitution modifier. However, they receive a -2 penalty to attack rolls and saving throws for 1 round due to impaired senses.]

2nd Level Spells:[
Frosty Libation: Cast as an action, conjures a 15-foot-radius sphere of freezing alcohol vapor centered on a point within range. Creatures within the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take 3d6 cold damage and have their speed halved until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, they take half damage and aren't slowed.

Drunken Resilience: As a bonus action, the Boozemancer drinks deeply from their Everflowing Mug, regaining hit points equal to 2d8 + their Constitution modifier. However, each use increases their inebriation, imposing a cumulative -1 penalty on Wisdom saving throws and skill checks until they take a short or long rest to sober up.
Frequency: Usable twice per long rest.

Boiling Buzz: Cast as an action, the Boozemancer concocts and hurls a volatile potion that bursts upon impact, spraying scalding liquor in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d4 fire damage and become poisoned until the end of their next turn, suffering from a debilitating buzz.

Stagger Swagger: As an action, the Boozemancer sips an enchanted brew that enhances their movements with a staggering gait, disconcerting to foes. For the next minute, any enemy that makes a melee attack against the Boozemancer must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become disoriented and have disadvantage on all melee attack rolls against the Boozemancer until the start of the enemy's next turn.

Tipsy Tempest: Cast as an action, the Boozemancer slams their mug on the ground, causing a surge of bewitched brew to spiral outward in a 20-foot radius centered on themselves. Allies within this radius gain temporary hit points equal to 1d6 plus the Boozemancer's Charisma modifier, representing a surge of drunken boldness. Enemies must make a Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with debilitating nausea, taking disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks for 1d4 rounds.]

3rd Level Spells:[
Liquid Courage: The Boozemancer downs an enchanted brew that invigorates their spirits and fortifies their flesh. They immediately regain hit points equal to 4d6 + Constitution modifier. Additionally, for the next 10 minutes, they gain resistance to fear and charm effects. But beware, each use leaves them more sloshed, adding a stacking penalty to Intelligence and Wisdom checks until the buzz wears off.
Frequency: Twice per long rest.

Barrel Roll: The Boozemancer summons an illusory barrel that rolls in a straight line for up to 30 feet. Each creature in its path must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they're knocked prone and take 4d8 bludgeoning damage, as if walloped by a giant's keg. On a successful save, they manage to dodge aside, taking only half damage.
Frequency: Once per short rest.

Crackling Concoction: The Boozemancer mixes a volatile potion that when thrown, explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 6d6 lightning damage, as static energy from the fizzing brew shocks them. Creatures that fail the saving throw by 5 or more are also stunned for 1 round due to the overwhelming shock.

Stupor Sludge: With a wave of their wand, the Boozemancer summons a pool of sticky, enchanted liquor that spans a 10-foot radius. Creatures stepping into the area must make a Strength saving throw or become restrained as they sink into the sludge. At the start of each of their turns, restrained creatures can attempt another Strength saving throw, ending the effect on a success. The sludge remains for 1 minute, and any creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must also make the saving throw.

Vomitus Volley: By chugging a dangerous draft, the Boozemancer lets out a noxious belch, sending a wave of acidic bile in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 6d6 acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, creatures that fail the saving throw are sickened and have disadvantage on all attack rolls and ability checks until the end of their next turn as they reel from the horrid stench and burning sensation.]

4th Level Spells:[
Grand Hangover: With a grand gesture, the Boozemancer summons a swirling vortex of alcohol-laden air. The spell affects all living enemies in a 20-foot radius centered on a point the Boozemancer can see within range. Victims caught in the maelstrom must make a Constitution saving throw or become sickened by a supernatural hangover. Affected enemies suffer a disadvantage on all attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks, and their movement is halved as nausea takes hold. If they fail save throws, they are incapacitated due to intense vomitting. The effect lasts for 1d4 rounds.
Frequency: Once per long rest.

Alestorm:
The Boozemancer summons a tempest of spirited winds, targeting a 30-foot-radius sphere within range. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw or be blinded by stinging alcohol and deafened by the howling gale for 1d4 rounds. Creatures that fail the saving throw by 5 or more are also knocked prone by the ferocious, boozy gusts.

Vinegar Vengeance:
Casting this spell causes the Boozemancer's blood to turn to acrid vinegar for a short time. The next time they take melee damage, their aggressor must make a Constitution saving throw or retch uncontrollably, becoming incapacitated for 1 round and taking 2d8 poison damage as the caustic liquid splashes back.

Spiritual Soak:
The Boozemancer designates a 20-foot cube within range. For the next minute, the area is drenched in a thick haze of intoxicating vapor. Allies in the cube gain temporary hit points equal to 1d6 plus the Boozemancer's Charisma modifier each round as their spirits are lifted by the alcoholic mist. Enemies must make a Constitution saving throw each round they start in the haze or take 1d6 poison damage and suffer disadvantage on all Wisdom-based checks and saving throws as their senses become dulled.]

5th Level Spells:[
Suds of Healing:
With a flourish, the Boozemancer summons forth a frothy deluge of magical ale that washes over them and their allies. Each creature of choice within range regains hit points equal to 5d8 + the Boozemancer's Intelligence modifier. This sudsy salve also has the side effect of making the targets mildly inebriated, giving them advantage on saving throws against fear for the next round.

Mirthquake:
Slamming their mug on the ground, the Boozemancer sends ripples of tremoring laughter through the earth. Enemies in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone, as uncontrollable laughter seizes their bodies. While prone in this way, the affected enemies take 2d6 psychic damage each round as their own giggles convulse through them.

Cask of Wonders:
Allies within 10 feet of the cask gain a +2 bonus to AC and advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. Additionally, allies regain 1d6 hit points at the start of their turn. The cask follows the caster for the duration of 1 minute or until dispelled.

Spirited Salvo:
The Boozemancer launches a volley of three magical booze bolts as an action. Each bolt can target the same creature or several creatures within a 60-foot range. Make a ranged spell attack for each bolt. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 force damage, and any creature within 5 feet of the target must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4 splash damage from the volatile spirits.]

6th Level Spells:[
Brewstorm:
The Boozemancer conjures a massive, swirling vortex of potent alcohol above a designated area, causing it to rain down in torrents upon the unfortunate souls below. Creatures caught in a 30-foot radius must make a Dexterity saving throw or be engulfed by the downpour, taking 8d6 acid damage as the spirits eat away at armor and flesh alike, while also becoming poisoned for the next minute.

Draught of the Titan:
The Boozemancer quaffs a powerful brew that momentarily transforms them into a hulking figure of strength and fortitude. They gain resistance to all physical damage, their size doubles – as do their hit points – and they can make one additional melee attack each turn. This transformation lasts for 1 minute, but when the spell ends, they suffer one level of exhaustion due to the immense toll on their body.

Liquid Labyrinth:
With a flamboyant wave and a flick of ale, the Boozemancer crafts an intricate maze of walls made from enchanted brew. Creatures must make an Intelligence saving throw to navigate through the maze or become hopelessly lost for the duration, which is up to 10 minutes. While trapped within, victims experience vivid hallucinations of their greatest desires and fears, keeping them ensnared and out of the fight.]

7th Level Spells:[
Spectral Distillery: As an action, create a spectral distillery that lasts for up to 1 minute. Allies within the mist gain a +3 bonus to saving throws and regenerate 1d10 hit points at the start of their turn. Enemies that enter or start their turn in the mist must make a Wisdom saving throw or be confused as if by the 'confusion' spell, seeing haunting visions and experiencing disorientation.

Ethereal Intoxication:
With a grand sweep of their arm, the Boozemancer conjures an otherworldly tavern from the celestial plane, pulling enemies within a 40-foot radius into an intoxicating realm. Here, the laws of physics are sodden with spirits, and foes must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or become utterly inebriated, losing the ability to distinguish friend from foe and attacking at random for the duration.

Brewmaster's Deluge:
Unleashing the ancestral power of dwarven brewing, the Boozemancer causes ale to erupt from the ground in geysers. Enemies in a 30-foot radius are pelted by the potent liquor, taking 7d6 bludgeoning damage as they're battered and soaked. Any creature caught in the deluge must make a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone by the force of the alcoholic eruption.]

8th Level Spells:[
Maelstrom of Misery:
Unleashes a torrent of spirits in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range, where reality distorts and every surface turns slick with cursed alcohol. Creatures within the maelstrom take 8d8 psychic damage as their deepest regrets and sorrows materialize before their eyes, and they must make a Wisdom saving throw or be rendered paralyzed by their own despair, unable to act for the duration.

Chalice of Rejuvenation:
Conjures an ornate goblet brimming with a divine elixir that glows with ethereal light. The Boozemancer or an ally may drink from the chalice as an action, completely restoring all hit points and curing all diseases, poisons, and curses. The intense potency of the elixir brings the drinker to the brink of intoxication, leaving them with a heady sense of euphoria that grants immunity to fear and charm effects for the next 24 hours.

Bacchanalian Bind:
Summons chains wrought from enchanted vines that erupt from the ground, seeking out up to six targets within a 60-foot radius. The targeted creatures must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be bound by the chains, which constrict tighter with every attempt to escape or attack. The vines emit a potent hallucinogenic nectar that seeps into the victims' pores; while bound, they experience vivid illusions that render them effectively stunned and at the mercy of their own minds' twisted fantasies.]


9th Level Spells:[
Tsunami of Intoxication:
The Boozemancer calls upon the ancient spirits of barley and hops, summoning forth a colossal wave of ale that crashes over the landscape. This unstoppable tide of inebriation sweeps through towns and countrysides alike, obliterating structures and flooding the streets with a deluge that drowns and dissolves anything in its path.

Mechanics: Creates a massive wave 60 feet high, 300 feet long, and 100 feet wide that moves at a speed of 30 feet per round. Structures and creatures caught in its wake suffer 10d20 bludgeoning damage each round, and must make a Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 1d4 hours due to overwhelming alcohol inhalation and ingestion.

Bender's Breath:
With a booming incantation, the Boozemancer exhales a breath so potent that it saturates the very air for miles around. All who breathe it in are struck by an ethereal drunkenness that dulls the mind and numbs the body.

Mechanics: Affects all creatures in a 2-mile radius. Creatures must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become overwhelmingly drunk, gaining four levels of exhaustion, disadvantage on all skill checks, saving throws, and attack rolls, and their movement speed is reduced to a stumble for 8 hours.

Goblet of the Infinite Toast:
The Boozemancer manifests an ornate goblet filled with an otherworldly liquor. Drinking from it or splashing its contents can grant life where there was none, turning desolation into a raucous celebration.

Mechanics: As an action, the Boozemancer can pour the goblet's contents onto the ground, causing vines heavy with grapes to erupt and form a banquet table fit for the gods. This sanctuary heals all within a 50-foot radius for 6d8+5 hit points each round and can revive those recently fallen in battle as if by the 'True Resurrection' spell. The feast and its effects last for 10 minutes before the vines wither and the enchantment fades.]


Special Abilities:[
Ale-fueled Frenzy:
Frequency: Usable once per combat encounter, must take a swig from the Everflowing Mug as a bonus action.
Mechanics: After drinking, the Boozemancer gains a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC for 10 minutes, stacking up to a maximum of +3. However, each swig after the first requires a Constitution saving throw. Failure means suffering a -1 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws due to impaired coordination.

Drunken Dodge:
Frequency: Passive ability.
Mechanics: The Boozemancer has trained their body to react unpredictably, granting them advantage on Dexterity saving throws against area effects. In addition, any time an area effect misses them due to Drunken Dodge, they may move up to 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks, as if they've literally stumbled out of danger.

Brew Blast:
Frequency: Can be used as an action, twice per short rest.
Mechanics: Unleashes a cone of alcoholic vapor that ignites upon contact with air, dealing 2d6 fire damage to all in its path and possibly intoxicating them.

Spirit Fog:
Frequency: Once per long rest, as an action.
Mechanics: Casts a dense fog smelling of strong spirits in a 20-foot radius. Obscures vision and can disorient enemies, causing disadvantage on their attack rolls and ability checks.

Guzzle of Fortitude:
In the heat of battle, the Boozemancer can chug a specially-prepared draught that fortifies their resolve.
Frequency: Usable twice per long rest.
Mechanics: The Boozemancer gains temporary hit points equal to 2d10 + their Constitution modifier. Additionally, for the next minute, they have advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.

Intoxicate Terrain:
Transforms the ground into a quagmire of sticky, enchanted alcohol, making it difficult for enemies to navigate.
Frequency: Once per long rest, as an action.
Mechanics: Affects a 50-foot square area, turning it into difficult terrain. Enemies within the area must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have their movement speed halved and suffer disadvantage on weapon attacks as long as they remain in the area. The effect lasts for 10 minutes.

Inebriating Aura:
The Boozemancer emits a potent aura of alcoholic fumes that seep into the minds and bodies of those nearby.
Frequency: Once per long rest, as an action.
Mechanics: The aura extends in a 30-foot radius from the Boozemancer for 1 minute. Allies in the aura are emboldened and gain +2 to attack rolls. Enemies must make a Wisdom saving throw each round they start in the aura or become confused as if under the effects of a 'confusion' spell.]
